main_text.p: denique omnia in quibus spem fiduciamq; suam col-locarat.

Nec obvolutus est ille.) Amplificatio poenarum & malorum per comparationem. Ac videtur in prophetae verbis aliquid per aposiopesin omissum, ad evidentius videlicet exprimendum vehementiam adfectus ac doloris. Est autem sententia: Isti qui in Iuda agen-tes contemnunt legem & testimonium, non tantum affligentur, sicut priori tempore adflicti fuerunt Israelitae, quando hostis Thiglat Pæleser[?] duas tribus occupavit ultra Iordanem, ac deinde transgressus etiam Iordanem, captiva deduxit dimidia tribum Manasse, Zebulon & Naphtali: aut, sicut etiam postea adflicti fuerunt per Salmanasar, qui captivas abduxit omnes decem tribus, adeoque universum Israel (qua de re 2. Reg. 15. & 17.) sed affligentur longe omnino gravius. Addito in hunc modum postremo membro, valde perspicua euadit[?] sententia.
main_text.head: CAPUT IX.
main_text.p: POpuli qui ambulant in tenebris, vide-runt lucem magnam: & qui habitat in terra umbrae mortis, lux fulsit super eos. Multiplicasti gentem, & (eidem) non magnificasti laeticiam: laetati enim sunt coram te secundum laeticia[?] quae fit in messe, & sicut exultant qui dividunt spolium. page.notes: The large initial P is joined to the first word as "POpuli". The word "Pæleser" (Thiglat Pælesser) is doubtful: the letters are read from the scan and marked [?]. "euadit" is read with doubt as "cuadit" in print, likely a printing error or a worn letter; marked [?]. "laeticia" before "quae" is doubtful: the joined form on the scan is unclear; marked [?]. "adfectus" is printed as "adfe-" and "ctus" across a line end without a visible hyphen, so it is written whole. Italics in the first paragraph are inferred from the gloss type.
